# Rule: fill each rectangle's interior with a checkerboard pattern using the color of the NEAREST stray pixel (Euclidean).
from collections import Counter
import math
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]!=0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for s in cells:
        if s in seen: continue
        st=[s]; comp={s}; seen.add(s)
        while st:
            i,j=st.pop()
            for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(i+di,j+dj)
                if n in cells and n not in seen:
                    seen.add(n); comp.add(n); st.append(n)
        comps.append(comp)
    rects=[]; strays=[]
    for comp in comps:
        rs=[i for i,_ in comp]; cs=[j for _,j in comp]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        ok = len(comp)==2*(r1-r0+1)+2*(c1-c0+1)-4 and (r1-r0)>=2 and (c1-c0)>=2
        bc=I[r0][c0]
        pure=all(I[i][j]==bc or I[i][j]==0 for i in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1))
        if ok and pure:
            rects.append((bc,(r0,r1,c0,c1)))
        strays.extend(comp)
    res=[[I[i][j] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    # clear all strays first
    res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for bc,(r0,r1,c0,c1) in rects:
        inner=[(i,j) for i in range(r0+1,r1) for j in range(c0+1,c1)]
        best=None
        for p in strays:
            d=(p[0]-r0)**2+(p[1]-c0)**2
            if best is None or d<best[0]: best=(d,p)
        d,p=best
        sc=I[p[0]][p[1]]
        par=((p[0]%2)^ (p[1]%2))
        for i,j in inner:
            if ((i-r0)%2==0)==par: res[i][j]=sc
    return res
print(f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])

from collections import Counter
def comps_of(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]!=0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for s in cells:
        if s in seen: continue
        st=[s]; comp={s}; seen.add(s)
        while st:
            i,j=st.pop()
            for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(i+di,j+dj)
                if n in cells and n not in seen:
                    seen.add(n); comp.add(n); st.append(n)
        comps.append(comp)
    return comps
for pair in [1,2]:
    key=f'Demo pair {pair}'
    I=G[f'{key} input']; O=G[f'{key} output']
    C=comps_of(I)
    rects=[]; strays=[]
    for comp in C:
        rs=[i for i,_ in comp]; cs=[j for _,j in comp]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        ok = len(comp)==2*(r1-r0+1)+2*(c1-c0+1)-4 and (r1-r0)>=2 and (c1-c0)>=2
        bc=I[r0][c0]
        pure=all(I[i][j]==bc or I[i][j]==0 for i in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1))
        if ok and pure:
            rects.append((bc,(r0,r1,c0,c1)))
        else:
            strays.extend(comp)
    print(f'--- Demo {pair}:')
    for bc,(r0,r1,c0,c1) in rects:
        # all strays with color counts, then distance of each color group to rect center (manhattan from centroid)
        groups=Counter([I[p[0]][p[1]] for p in strays]).most_common()
        print('   fill candidates:',[(c,[dist(p,(r0+r1//2,c0+c1//2)) for p in comps_of(I)] ) for c,_ in groups])

import os,re,numpy as np,json,scipy.ndimage as ndi
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
m=list(re.finditer(r'Test input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t))[0]
T=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:int(m[1])]])
mask=(T==4)|(T==5)|(T==8)
out=T.copy(); out[mask]=0
# sanity: check each remaining nonzero comp is a complete rectangle border
lab2,n2=ndi.label(out!=0)
print('remaining comps',n2)
ok=True
for i in range(1,n2+1):
    ys,xs=np.where(lab2==i); c=set(T[np.where(lab2==i)])
    h=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; w=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
    bb=[(r,c2) for r in range(min(ys),max(ys)+1) for c2 in range(min(xs),max(xs)+1) if ((r in (min(ys),max(ys))) or (c2 in (min(xs),max(xs))))]
    okb = len(set(zip(ys,xs))==len(bb)) if False else set(zip(ys,xs))==set(bb)
    print(i,c,'bbox',h,w,'complete border' if okb else 'NOT complete')
print(json.dumps(out.tolist()))

    if h>1 and w>1:
        col=set(T[np.where(lab==i)].tolist())
        if len(col)==1:
            c=col.pop()
            bb=[(r,c2) for r in range(min(ys),max(ys)+1) for c2 in range(min(xs),max(xs)+1)]

                for r in range(min(ys),max(ys)+1):
                    for c2 in range(min(xs),max(xs)+1):

def solve(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])

    def comp(cells):  # flood fill from a seed
        st=set(cells); out=[]
        while st:

            if seen[y][x]: continue
            seen[y][x]=True; out.append((y,x))
            for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

                if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx] in cells_set:
                    st.add((ny,nx))
        return out
    comps=[]; cs={}  # color -> cells
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v!=0 and not seen[r][c]:
                seen[r][c]=True
                comp_=comp([(r,c)])
                cs[v]=cs.get(v,set())|set(comp_)
    def is_frame(cells,v):
        ys=[p[0] for p in cells]; xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
        h=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; w=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
        area=h*w; return len(cells)>=area*0.4
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    for v,cells in cs.items():

            for p in cells: seen[p[0]][p[1]]=False
            ys=[p[0] for p in cells]; xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
            y0,y1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
            enclosed=[p for p in comp(set([(y,x) for y in range(y0,y1+1) for x in range(x0,x1+1) if g[y][x]==0])) if True]
